facts.value: A healthy diet in combination with being active can help those with diabetes keep their blood sugar in check.
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree

facts.value: The US CDC advises individuals with diabetes to plan for regular, balanced meals and to include more nonstarchy vegetables, reduce added sugars and refined grains, and focus on whole foods instead of highly processed foods.
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree

facts.value: Generally, people with diabetes and those at risk are encouraged to increase their fiber intake.
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree
